scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Aaa.. Are you going to go into there?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
啊...你要进去吗？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
You'd better release your transformation if you'd like to enter. It could be dangerous in some ways.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
想进去的话，最好先解除变身，否则可能出危险。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Ah, wait! Please wait. This is not a good place for a promising young man like you!
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
啊，等等！请等一下。这里不是你这样前途无量的年轻人该来的地方！

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Ah, wait! Please wait. This is not a good place for a promising young woman like you!
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
啊，等等！请等一下。这里不是你这样前途无量的年轻人该来的地方！

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
If you must, come back later after you become far stronger. Hmmm.. I would say.. Lv.140?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
如果你一定要去，等你变得更强之后再来吧。嗯...我觉得...140级？

scripts.text: ^ff0000Be cautious taming or other ways than hunting monsters are not considered as normal killing counts.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000请注意，驯服等非正常讨伐方式不计入魔物击杀数。^000000

scripts.text: [Catherine Jet Johnson]
scripts.translation: [凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Do.. Don't be afraid of me. Now I look ugly, but I wasn't like this before.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
别...别怕我。我现在看起来很丑，但我以前不是这样的。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Kimi's soul is still staying in this ground. When I can let her rest in peace...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
基米的灵魂还徘徊在这里。
到底什么时候，才能让她安息...

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Done. Let me try to open the closed door.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
好了。让我试着打开那扇紧闭的门。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe skull-faced girl in front of you is speaking in a tearful voice. Void holes where there should be eyes are staring at you.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff面前那个骷髅脸的女孩用带着哭腔的声音说着话。本该是眼睛的位置只有两个空洞，正盯着你。^000000

scripts.text: What's wrong with your face?
scripts.translation: 你的脸怎么了？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
This is a long story.. Would you mind if I talk to you? If you waste your time on someone like me?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
说来话长...你愿意听我讲吗？
把时间花在我这样的人身上，会不会耽误你？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出

scripts.text: Please keep talking.
scripts.translation: 请继续说

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Okay, take care of yourself. And don't ever come near that odd entrance.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
好吧，照顾好自己。千万不要靠近那个奇怪的入口。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Mmm.. Where should I start.. The story of this town first?...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
嗯...该从哪儿说起呢...先说说这座镇子吧？

scripts.text: ^0000ffWith a sigh, the girl begins to speak in a subdued tone like a bard who tells an old story.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff女孩叹了口气，用低沉的语调开始讲述，就像一位吟游诗人讲述古老的故事。^000000

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
There was a toy factory in this town. All of the people in this town work there and I was one of the employees.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
这个城镇里有一家玩具工厂。镇上的人都在那里工作，我也是其中一名员工。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
We all were happy in the beginning. We used to gather around together and have a friendly chat having gingerbread and hot tea after work.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
起初我们都很快乐。下班后，我们总是聚在一起，吃着姜饼，喝着热红茶，愉快地聊天。

scripts.text: I couldn't even imagine, seeing this mood...
scripts.translation: 看这里现在的样子，真难想象...

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Yes, because we couldn't earn a living by packaging toys forever. The situations got tough after the villagers left in ones and twos.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
是啊，靠包装玩具，终究没法一直养活大家。
镇民们一个接一个离开，日子也越来越难。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
I was the one who worked as an assistant beside the doll craftsman who made dolls to the end.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
只有我这个助手，一直陪在那位坚持制作玩偶的工匠身边，直到最后。

scripts.text: ^0000ffI could feel her slender jawbone is trembling due to the subtle change of her emotion.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff我能感觉到她纤细的下颌骨因情绪的细微变化而微微颤抖。^000000

scripts.text: Ask her to continue.
scripts.translation: 请她继续说

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
On the day when the factory is decided to be closed, the doll maker dressed the last doll he made and shed tears.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
决定关闭工厂的那天，工匠给最后做出的玩偶穿上衣服，流下了眼泪。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Perhaps he thought he wouldn't make dolls anymore.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
也许他认为自己再也不会制作玩偶了。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
He named the last doll ^0000ffCeline Kimi^000000 and stopped all the lines in the factory.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
他给最后一个玩偶取名为^0000ff席琳·基米^000000，并停止了工厂里所有的生产线。

scripts.text: Did he give a doll a name?
scripts.translation: 他给玩偶取了名字？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Sometimes so much work goes into a doll as if it were their child to doll makers. Kimi was the one for him.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
工匠有时会把全部心血倾注在一个玩偶上，待它如自己的孩子。
对他而言，基米就是这样的存在。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
I guess his earnestness breathed life to Kimi.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
我想，正是他的这份真挚赋予了基米生命。

scripts.text: Do you mean the doll is alive?
scripts.translation: 你是说玩偶活过来了？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Yes, ^0000ffShe^000000 became a living creature. I don't know how, but she is striding in the toy factory with heavy sorrow and rage.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
是的，^0000ff她^000000活了过来。
我不知道是怎么回事，可她满怀悲伤和愤怒，至今还在玩具工厂里徘徊。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
When I first saw her, she was standing beside the doll maker who died and collapsed. She stood there with a bare expression.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
我第一次见到活过来的她时，工匠已经倒地死去了。
她就站在他身旁，脸上没有一丝表情。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
That's the end. I was outside when I woke up again after I had blacked out. My face has become like this.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
之后我就昏了过去，再醒来时，人已在外面，脸也成了这样。

scripts.text: Did Kimi do that?
scripts.translation: 是基米做的吗？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
I don't know.. She would do it, or it could be a different problem. I have no memory of it.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
不知道...也许是她，也许另有原因。
我什么都不记得。

scripts.text: Do you blame her?
scripts.translation: 你责怪她吗？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Ah, no. I don't blame her! I just want to know what happened to the doll craftsman on that day.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
啊，不。我不责怪她！我只是想知道那天玩偶工匠身上到底发生了什么。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
I don't think the scene I saw was everything. However, getting into the factory again is.. Re-entering there is...
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
我看到的应该不是全部真相。
可要再进工厂...再回到那里...

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Yes, I am scared and reluctant to do it. If there's someone who can help me..
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
是的，我很害怕，也很犹豫。如果有谁能帮我的话...

scripts.text: I am not very helpful to you.
scripts.translation: 我可能帮不上什么忙

scripts.text: Maybe I can help you with it.
scripts.translation: 也许我能帮上忙

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Thank you for.. for listening to me. Hope you will enjoy your trip..
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
谢谢你...愿意听我倾诉。希望你的旅途愉快...

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Heh? You would do me a favor?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
诶？你愿意帮我？

scripts.text: Let's get into the factory.
scripts.translation: 我们进工厂吧

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
We.. Well, I cannot help you at all except for providing you with directions. Besides, this can be very dangerous to you.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
可...我除了指路，什么忙也帮不上。
而且那里对你来说可能很危险。

scripts.text: You can reunite with Kimi, can't you?
scripts.translation: 你可以和基米重逢，不是吗？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Kimi, you mean Kimi..
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
基米，你是说基米...

scripts.text: ^0000ffShe is thinking about something intently with gaping eyes.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff她正瞪大眼睛，似乎在认真地思考着什么。^000000

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
I.. I've decided. It won't be a great help to you, but I can simply let you know the directions.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
我...决定了。
虽然帮不上大忙，但至少可以为你指路。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Wait, please wait until I am prepared. I can guide you when I am ready.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
请等一下，让我准备准备。
准备好了就能为你带路。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou need to organize a party having more than one member to get into Horror Toy Factory.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff进入恐怖玩具工厂需要先组建一支至少2人的队伍。^000000

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Eh.. Give me a second. I am talking to the person in charge. Please wait a little bit.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
呃...请等一下，我正在和负责人说话。

scripts.text: Unlock Horror Toy Factory
scripts.translation: 解锁恐怖玩具工厂

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Door will be.. opened soon.. Would you wait for a moment?
scripts.translation: 门很快就会打开...请稍等片刻。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
The smell of preservative from the factory has not gone away. You cannot enter under this state.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
工厂里的防腐剂气味还没散，现在还不能进去。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
I will keep you from entering until the scent of preservative is completely gone.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
等防腐剂气味彻底散去，我才能让你进去。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe smell of preservative has gone away. You can talk to Catherine Jet Johnson.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff防腐剂的味道已经消散了。你可以与凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊交谈。^000000

scripts.text:
[Factory Dimension Teleporter]
There are some work study programs as monster workers during the Horror Toy Factory tour. Therefore, ^ff0000you are unable to enter when you are transformed.^000000
scripts.translation:
[工厂次元传送器]
参观恐怖玩具工厂时，需要体验扮演魔物工人的工作。
因此，^ff0000处于变身状态时无法进入。^000000

scripts.text:
[Factory Dimension Teleporter]
You are not eligible for dimensional shifting. You should be at least Lv.140.
scripts.translation:
[工厂次元传送器]
你的实力不足以进行次元转移，请达到140级后再来。

scripts.text:
[Factory Dimension Teleporter]
You don't have any support? Please organize a party and come again if you go in alone.
scripts.translation:
[工厂次元传送器]
没有同伴支援吗？即使独自前往，也请先组建队伍再来。

scripts.text: An unknown error has occurred.
scripts.translation: 发生未知错误。

scripts.text: The gateway for dimensional shifting has not been activated.
scripts.translation: 次元转移的通道尚未激活。

scripts.text:
[Factory Dimension Teleporter]
You don't have any support? Please organize a party and come again if you go in alone.
scripts.translation:
[工厂次元传送器]
没有同伴支援吗？即使独自前往，也请先组建队伍再来。

scripts.text: You already have a trail of dimensional shifting. Your access has been denied.
scripts.translation: 你身上还留着次元转移的痕迹，无法进入。

scripts.text: ^0000ffThe trail of dimensional shifting disappeared. You are allowed to use Factory Dimension Teleporter.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff次元转移的痕迹已消失。你可以使用工厂次元传送器了。^000000

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
You cannot come here if you are under the effect of a monster transformation.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
如果你正处于魔物变身状态，是无法进入这里的。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Please wait until the transformation is finished. You cannot move to another area until you become normal.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
请等变身结束，恢复原状后才能前往下一区域。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Eh.. Give me a second. I am talking to the person in charge. Please wait.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
呃...稍等，我正在和负责人说话。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Everyone is in their mortal corruptible state right?
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
大家都处于正常的人类状态，对吧？

scripts.text: Quit the story
scripts.translation: 退出剧情

scripts.text: Listen to her story.
scripts.translation: 听她的故事

scripts.text: I know your situation. Let's start quickly!
scripts.translation: 我知道你的情况。快点开始吧！

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Oh, dear. Let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
天哪。等你准备好了再告诉我。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou put on a factory uniform. There still seems to be a few uniforms left in the box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你穿上了工厂制服。箱子里似乎还剩下几套制服。^000000

scripts.text:
^ff0000You are in transformation.
You cannot use the uniform box when already transformed.^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000你正处于变身状态。
在变身状态下无法使用制服箱。^000000

scripts.text:
[Coordinator]
I can't find the other workers. We don't have time for dawdling. Children are waiting for presents.
scripts.translation:
[协调员]
我找不到其他工人了。我们没有时间磨蹭了。孩子们正在等待礼物。

scripts.text:
[Coordinator]
Why are you hanging around! Carry ^ff0000the gift box over here^000000 and move to the east.
scripts.translation:
[协调员]
还磨蹭什么！带上^ff0000这里的礼物箱^000000，往东走。

scripts.text:
[Coordinator]
What!? Humans!!!
scripts.translation:
[协调员]
什么！？人类！！！

scripts.text:
[Coordinator]
Hurry up! Carry ^ff0000the gift box over there^000000 and move to the east.
scripts.translation:
[协调员]
快点！带上^ff0000那边的礼物箱^000000，往东走。

scripts.text: ^0000ffYou are carrying the packaged present.^000000
scripts.translation: ^0000ff你正拿着包装好的礼物。^000000

scripts.text: ^009900The box is in your hands. You cannot carry more than one box.^000000
scripts.translation: ^009900箱子已经在你手中了。你一次只能拿一个箱子。^000000

scripts.text: ^ff0000You are not in uniform. The Coordinator won't let you pick it up.^000000
scripts.translation: ^ff0000你没有穿制服。协调员不让你拿。^000000

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Lucky you got here safely.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
幸好你平安到这里了。

scripts.text: Quit the story
scripts.translation: 退出剧情

scripts.text: Listen to her tactics.
scripts.translation: 听听她的战术

scripts.text: I know what to do. Proceed quickly!
scripts.translation: 我知道该怎么做。快点行动！

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Oh, dear. Let me know when you are ready.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
天哪。等你准备好了再告诉我。

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Hold on~ I am talking to your manager, so please wait.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
稍等~我正在和你们的队长说话。

scripts.text: ^0000ff>You changed into uniform.^000000

^ff0000You transformed into a different form.
You can't seem to put on the uniform over your fangs.^000000
scripts.translation:
^ff0000你变成了别的模样。
顶着这副獠牙，似乎没法穿上制服。^000000

scripts.text:
[Worker]
Huh? What happened?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
嗯？发生什么事了？

scripts.text: No, nothing special
scripts.translation: 不，没什么特别的

scripts.text: Do you know about the doll maker?
scripts.translation: 你知道那个玩偶工匠吗？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'm very busy with working, so could you stop chatting?
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我工作很忙，所以你能不能别闲聊了？

scripts.text:
[Worker]
I'm working now! I'm very busy!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
我正在工作！我很忙！

scripts.text:
[Worker]
What!? You are not one of us!!
scripts.translation:
[工人]
什么！？你不是我们的人！！

scripts.text:
[Captured Santa]
Even if no one owns it, its not right to steal it from everyone.
scripts.translation:
[被俘的圣诞老人]
就算东西没有主人，也不能从大家手里抢走。

scripts.text:
[Antonio]
Hey, Santa. Stop being stuffy, you old man. Fair is fair after all, kekeke.
scripts.translation:
[安东尼奥]
喂，圣诞老头，别这么死板嘛。
公平就是公平，嘿嘿嘿。

scripts.text:
[Celine Kimi]
Did you come here as well? Why are all of the humans so anxious to destroy what we built?
scripts.translation:
[席琳·基米]
你也来这里了吗？为什么所有人类都这么急着摧毁我们建立的东西？

scripts.text:
[Catherine Jet Johnson]
Wa.. Watch out! Kimi isn't under the normal status.
scripts.translation:
[凯瑟琳·杰特·约翰逊]
小...小心！基米的状态不对劲。

scripts.text:
[Celine Kimi]
You also... came here to kill me?
scripts.translation:
[席琳·基米]
你也是...来杀我的吗？

scripts.text: Will you exit?
scripts.translation: 你要离开吗？

scripts.text: Take a look around
scripts.translation: 四处看看

scripts.text: Go outside
scripts.translation: 走到外面

scripts.text: Stop the machine.
scripts.translation: 关闭机器。

scripts.text:
[Time Manager]
What time would you like to return?
scripts.translation:
[时间管理员]
你想返回哪个时间点？

scripts.text: Cancel
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text: Factory No.1 Complete
scripts.translation: 1号工厂完成

scripts.text: Factory No.2 Complete
scripts.translation: 2号工厂完成

scripts.text: Factory No.3 Complete
scripts.translation: 3号工厂完成

scripts.text: Boss Start
scripts.translation: 首领战开始

scripts.text: Boss Complete
scripts.translation: 首领战结束
